title: History & Culture
notes:
World History Milestones

  • Ancient civilizations: Mesopotamia, Egypt (Nile), Indus Valley (Mohenjo-daro, Harappa), China (Yellow River).
  • World Wars: WWI 1914–1918, WWII 1939–1945; the UN was founded after WWII.
  • Industrial Revolution: began in Britain in the late 18th century (steam power, factories).
  • Great discoveries: America (1492, Columbus), sea route to India (1498, Vasco da Gama).
  • Space race: Sputnik-1 (1957), first Moon landing Apollo 11 (1969, Neil Armstrong).

Culture Terms

  • Heritage: sites recognized by UNESCO; Nepal has 4 World Heritage Sites in Kathmandu Valley + Lumbini.
  • Languages: over 120 languages spoken in Nepal; Nepali is the official language.
  • Festivals: Dashain, Tihar, Chhath, Holi, Eid, Christmas — reflecting Nepal's multicultural society.
